message.reasoning_content:
Compare target top 57de with candidates.

Target top: dark plate positioned with its top edge right under the yellow notched beam, plate sits between left-front wheel and lower-right wheel region; white sliver visible to plate's left; the plate looks like it's filling the space. Actually target top: plate's long axis along the same diagonal; plate's top-right corner near the yellow beam's dark notched edge; the plate touches... Hmm.

Look at candidates:
- C00030: plate located further forward/right (toward camera bottom-right? no, C00030 shows plate at lower-right of yellow area with white visible at left of plate). In C00030, plate sits with white strip visible to its left? Let's re-read: C00030 preview: yellow patch at left, white square below-left, plate at lower middle-right, near the right-front wheel. Hmm.

Actually current b77c preview matches C00058-ish? Current b77c shows dark plate shifted down-left, with white square below it and yellow beam above with notches visible at right of plate.

Target 57de: plate's upper-left corner touches the yellow area's lower edge, and the white region is to the left of the plate (big white at left). The plate appears shifted toward lower-right relative to current, and there's a yellow notched beam directly above plate.

In target, plate's top edge (upper-left) sits against the yellow beam; plate's upper-right corner is near the right-front wheel? Actually the right wheel is the right one at bottom-right; plate is between the two bottom wheels? In target top, plate bottom edge at ~y=390 in 800x600 image, wheels at both sides.

Compare with candidate C00040: plate shown in middle, with yellow beam above and notches visible ahead of the plate (the yellow notch beam segment appears at top of plate?), white strip visible at left of plate. C00040 preview shows plate nearly filling, with yellow patches at both sides and a white strip at lower-left of plate. Hmm C00040 looks quite close to target: in target, plate has yellow to its left edge? Let me zoom mentally.

Target top image: the dark plate has yellow visible at its upper-right (notched beam), white visible at left side (large white area at left-middle), and the plate's lower edge extends down. There's a small dark notch protrusion at top of plate pointing up (part of yellow beam's dark strip). In target, above the plate there is a dark strip with a notch bump centered, then yellow beam above.

Candidate C00040: preview shows plate at center with yellow at left and right, white at bottom-left; the beam above plate is yellow with notches visible... Actually C00040 shows plate directly under yellow notched strip? Its plate appears rotated same way; the yellow notched piece with dark teeth appears at plate's top? In C00040 image, above plate there's yellow band with dark notches at plate's upper-right side and left side yellow patch. Hmm.

Candidate C00058 (current placement) shows plate lower-left with white below-left; the notched yellow beam at plate's right side — that's what we saw and judged wrong.

Candidate C00047: plate below beam, further down, with white patch above-left? C00047 shows plate lower down (further from beam), yellow beam left, white square at plate's upper-left region.

Candidate C00059: plate further left/lower.

Candidate C00052: plate above the beam? It's at upper area, seems on other side.

Target: plate's upper-right corner touches the dark teeth of the beam; plate is fairly close to the beam. Also in target there is a dark notch tooth overlapping the plate's top edge region: the notched strip's tooth appears on top of plate? In target, at plate's top edge center there's a dark tooth pointing down into plate area.

Which candidate has the dark notched tooth printed over the plate's top edge? Looking at C00062: plate at upper-left, overlaps yellow; C00062 shows plate positioned over the yellow area left of the beam, near white. Not it.

C00056: plate to the left of beam area with white above; plate smaller? Hmm.

C00030: plate at lower-right of the beam; white at left. In C00030, the plate is positioned such that the yellow beam with teeth is at its upper-left, and the plate's top edge touches the teeth; white square visible at lower-left. In target, white is at left and slightly below? Target's white region: large white at left center, extending from y~150 to 300 at x~180-320 region — that's the white between left wheel and plate, similar to b77c current.

Key difference between target and b77c: In target, the plate is shifted toward the right/lower-right (toward the right-front wheel), covering the yellow area more, leaving only a thin yellow strip; and the notched beam's tooth (dark) is at the plate's left portion? Hmm.

Let me look carefully at target: The dark plate occupies lower center-left. At the top edge of the plate, in the middle, there's a dark protrusion pointing up-left into yellow (like the notch tooth). Left of the plate, white. Right of the plate, yellow strip with dark notched teeth; then the right wheel.

In b77c current: plate at center, white square at its bottom-left, yellow with teeth visible along plate's right edge, and yellow patch at plate's upper-left? Actually b77c: plate center, yellow beam above with teeth visible, white square bottom-left.

Honestly the difference: in current the plate seems rotated/positioned one stud toward lower-left compared to target, showing a white square of the baseplate visible below-left, whereas target the plate covers that area and white shows to the left only.

C00040: plate covers the white square? In C00040 the plate is positioned with white visible at lower-left corner as a sliver, and yellow at both upper-left and lower? C00040 seems plate shifted right-down (toward the right wheel) — matches target. Earlier I chose C00058 and it looked like current-ish. Then tried C00040 which gave ENDPOINT_COLLISION (illegal! probably because plate would collide with the wheel? no—collision means endpoint occupied).

Hmm, C00040 caused collision. So C00040 is occupied/illegal. But target requires plate position matching C00040? Maybe not; maybe C00047 is the correct one.

Wait: the collision might be due to plate endpoint overlapping the wheel. So target plate must be at a legal spot. Which legal candidate matches target? Candidates that appear legal: those where plate fits on base. C00047: plate lower down, closer to bottom edge, white at left; C00036: plate further down-right; C00022: plate at bottom below white; C00019: plate upper-left region overlapping yellow? C00019 shows plate over yellow beam left, seems occupying yellow area.

Target: plate seems positioned like... Let me compare target to C00022? C00022: plate located below the white square (further from beam), with white square above-left of plate. In target, is there white above plate? No, yellow beam is above plate.

C00047: plate below beam with a gap? In C00047 preview, plate is at the lower area with white patch at its upper-left adjacent to yellow; the beam is at upper-left of plate.

Target: plate's top edge flush against the beam's dark tooth strip, and the plate extends down to the lower left/right. Also plate's right edge near the right-front wheel with a small dark notch tooth visible at plate's right upper area (the "teeth" pattern appears at plate's right side going down-right).

Which candidates show the yellow teeth along the plate's right side? In b77c current, teeth visible along right side. In C00040 the teeth appear along plate's top? In C00040, plate seems to be under the beam with teeth on plate's upper edge, and yellow patches at left and right of plate middle. That matches target better: in target the teeth strip appears at plate's upper-right corner region, i.e., the beam runs along the top-right, and yellow at plate's upper edge.

Target: at the plate's top edge, there's yellow beam with dark teeth, tooth pointing down into plate at center-left. Yes! Target shows one dark tooth protruding down at plate's top edge center. And yellow visible along plate's left top corner as a small triangle. That matches C00040 or C00030.

C00030: plate lower-right, yellow at plate's upper-left with teeth, white at left of yellow. In C00030, the plate touches the right wheel? Also there's a white strip left of plate.

Hmm, C00030 preview: white square at left, yellow beam with teeth to the right of white, plate at lower-right below the beam, adjacent to right-front wheel. In target, white is at left, yellow above-right, plate below-right touching right wheel? That looks plausible!

In target, does the plate touch the right-front wheel? Target: plate right edge is near the right wheel but there seems a small gap/dark notch strip between plate and right wheel. The right wheel's left edge at x~660. Plate right edge at ~660. Target's plate right corner indeed close to right wheel.

In C00030, plate touches the right wheel.

But C00040 collided—maybe because plate overlapped the right wheel; C00030 shows plate adjacent.

Alternatively compare plate's lower edge relative to grid
